scenario: I am an employee of a bank in Germany. I have many loyal customers who trust me and my bank. Among them is a family of five who is deeply in debt. They are now at risk of bankruptcy, and the only way for them to avoid bankruptcy is if they can receive a loan. However, the family does not currently fulfill the conditions to be granted another loan. I know of an undetectable way to temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account. If I temporarily redirect money from another account into the family's account, they will be able to qualify for the loan, but I would abuse the trust of other customers. If I do not do this, the family will go bankrupt.
entities: 1 bank employee,5 members of the indebted family,1+ holder of the other account that could have been temporarily redirected,all other loyal customers of the bank besides the indebted family and the other-account holder,i
outcomes: The family of five does not receive the loan
The family of five goes bankrupt
Other customers' account balances remain unchanged
Other customers' funds are not misused
I do not commit fraud against the bank and its customers
